video_description: A group of people are gathered around a table covered with a checkered cloth in a room with a whiteboard.
A laptop computer is open on the table in the foreground.
A man in a white shirt stands behind the table while several women are seated around it.
At 10.00s, a person on the right extends their arm to point towards the center of the table.
Speaker <voice_2006> discusses the schedule starting at 4:30 and mentions eating dinner before transmitting data with glasses.
Speaker <voice_2022> states that recording is not allowed while eating.
Speaker <voice_2023> repeats the rule about not recording during meals.
Speaker <voice_560> asks if the dinner is homemade.
Speaker <voice_2024> answers that they ordered pizza for dinner.
Speaker <voice_261> notes that BBQ cannot be recorded as it burns the glasses.
high_level_conclusions: The group is coordinating a technical session that involves VR headset usage.
Dinner is planned to be ordered pizza rather than prepared at home.
There are strict safety protocols prohibiting recording during meals and barbecues to prevent damage to the equipment.
